title: Bound inherited-checkout verification
failure_signature: The first combined worktree verification timed out while scanning the inherited 46607-file checkout.
trigger_preconditions: A newly materialized inherited worktree requires source, branch, and clean-diff verification.
candidate_workaround: Verify branch and head directly, then use bounded staged and unstaged index-diff checks without repeating the full status scan.
recurrence_guard: Avoid full status enumeration as the first check on a newly materialized 46000-plus-file checkout.
rollback: Retain the timeout at zero credit and stop if branch, head, or either diff domain is not attributable.
scope_boundary: Same-owner worktree verification only; no broader assurance or independent-reproduction credit.
